title: Compose Design Split Layout Always For Mcp
description: ComposeDesign collapsed to single-column diagram when hasPlanes false even on correct surface. Added splitLayout auto|always, pure composeDesignGridTemplateColumns + composeDesignShowSceneColumn, McpDesignViewer passes always. Tests assert two columns never 1fr when always.
summary: Root cause of full-width diagram in design-viewer: ComposeDesign used hasPlanes to hide the scene column and grid 1fr, so users saw diagram-only even when McpDesignViewer mounted ComposeDesign. Added ComposeDesignSplitLayout (auto|always), pure composeDesignGridTemplateColumns + composeDesignShowSceneColumn (unit-tested: always+no planes => two columns not 1fr), data-compose-design-columns on root. McpDesignViewer passes splitLayout=always for design surface. vitest 179/179 passed.
